description: This file defines the ClientStatus enum class, representing different status states for clients within the application. It includes methods for converting from integers and strings to enum values, and provides status-specific boolean checks.

classes.name: ClientStatus
classes.description: Enum representing various client status states such as INVALID, PENDING, ACTIVE, etc. It provides utility methods for status conversion and checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an Integer status code to a corresponding ClientStatus enum value.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a String representation of status to the corresponding ClientStatus enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current ClientStatus instance matches a given ClientStatus state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the ClientStatus.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the ClientStatus.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Returns true if the status is PENDING.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns true if the status is ACTIVE.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns true if the status is CLOSED.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Returns true if the status is REJECTED.

methods.name: isWithdrawn
methods.description: Returns true if the status is WITHDRAWN.

methods.name: isTransferInProgress
methods.description: Returns true if the status indicates transfer is in progress.

methods.name: isTransferOnHold
methods.description: Returns true if the transfer is on hold.

methods.name: isUnderTransfer
methods.description: Returns true if the transfer is either in progress or on hold.
